user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update task description with valid text
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Select a specific task to view its details
Enter a new valid description text
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully and visible on the task details page.

negative.title: Update task description with prohibited characters
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Select a specific task to view its details
Enter a description with prohibited characters (e.g., <script>)
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid characters and the description is not updated.

edge.title: Update task description with maximum allowed length
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Select a specific task to view its details
Enter a description with the maximum allowed length
edge.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully without truncation.
